title: Causal structure: timelike, spacelike and lightlike
summary: Light speed as the limit on causality; the three relations between events and their frame independence; invariance of time order for timelike pairs; the light cone and the regions of spacetime; why superluminal signals would reverse cause and effect.

objectives.description: Objectives will be finalised when the unit is prepared; the source material is Spacetime Physics Chapter 6, Tong Sections 7.2.2 and 7.3.1, and MIT 8.20 Week 2 (Lectures 5.4–5.5).

preparation.description: Read Spacetime Physics Chapter 6 Regions of Spacetime (pp. 171–188): 6.1 Light Speed: Limit on Causality, 6.2 Relation Between Events, 6.3 Light Cone.
Re-read Section 1.4 (pp. 11–13) on timelike and spacelike intervals.
Second account: Tong, Dynamics and Relativity, Section 7.2 (7.2.2 Causality) and Section 7.3 (7.3.1 The Invariant Interval: timelike, spacelike, lightlike), reference-only.
Optional: MIT 8.20 Week 2 videos, Lecture 5.4 Regions in Spacetime Diagrams and Lecture 5.5 Causality.
